meaning: Review assignments, not a trust whitelist or a claim that these implementations are proved. Exact native source is frozen separately. Every compiled body stays in the private full index, including excluded template algorithms.

sandproof-guest-core.note: T9 compatibility algorithms excluded; Guest safety is not excluded.

drop_review.effect: If the original counts mutex is acquired, decrement total/per-instance and remove a zero row. Poison may prevent credit; key comparison and counter validity remain own obligations.
Attempt to send cancellation; does not observe decoder or blocking worker exit.
Attempt stop/reap of the original child; on uncertain bounded wait, transfer child and slot to the original reaper. Drop is not an unconditional exit receipt.
Decrement active-helper accounting; ownership must show no live helper loses its slot.
Attempt unlock of the original controller-only open file; not a per-child ownership release policy.
Attempt unlock of the original profile coordination file; retain failed-unlock/deployment conditions.
Attempt unlock of the original writer file; does not establish durable Redis commit or absence of another writer by itself.
Attempt explicit controller-store unlock, including transient fork-before-exec descriptor copies; not database recovery evidence.
If an owned transaction remains, attempt rollback; invalidate committed memo on rollback error. Does not roll back VM or network effects.
Move the original child to its reaper; channel failure falls back to kill/wait. Transfer is not an exit observation and fallback may block.
Attempt cache-file unlock. Template implementation is an engineering boundary; authorized immutable input binding at core use stays required.
If exit was not confirmed, mark the original lease Unknown. Never create a drained/physical-exit receipt.
Attempt original PID-claim writer unlock; does not retire persistent PID identity or prove process exit.
Request kill using original pidfd or not-yet-reaped Child; no repeated numeric kill after uncertain wait. No unconditional wait/exit guarantee.
Unless launch is Released, attempt KILL through original pidfd. No wait, exit or automatic capacity credit.
When unfinished, quarantine unsettled permit with forget, publish OwnerLost and reply Unknown. This is not B1's normal permit return.
When unsettled, take/forget record permit, fail streams and mark owner loss; requires original shared-object/lock identity.
Free own bytes and output before sending release time; later field destruction and retained Arc owners still matter.
Remove only the pending original tag under original table lock, including poison recovery; do not repair an active record.
If record was not explicitly removed, mark that original record Unknown; not a process-exit or release certificate.
Free own bytes before releasing producer backpressure; other byte/lease clones are separate ownership obligations.
Store abandoned=true if the original Incoming was not ended; this triggers bounded transport closeout, not successful request completion.
Free own bytes before producer acknowledgement; original dynamic owner remains a field and may have observable Drop.
Attempt cancellation notification; does not join the admitted blocking source.
If armed, attempt cancellation on the original signal. Notification is not worker exit.

unresolved.item: Resolve actual Fn/trait/dyn targets and Arc<dyn Send+Sync> owners per call. A literal call/type line is not that binding.

Compiler-generated future cancellation/drop glue, nested dependency destructors, all capture/field drop order and panic-in-drop require per-use Rust/approved-adapter review; stable emitted MIR does not close these obligations.
Signature/local types are indexed literally; expanded structural fields/schema and legal runtime instances still require their existing per-type/source checks.
Configured external executables, Python/shell helpers, FFI/kernel/VM/TLS effects and their complete invocation binding are not made proved by compiling Rust roots.
